target_text: USMC SBDs (VMSB 132) from Henderson Field sink heavy cruiser Kinugasa 15 nautical miles northwest of Rendova
notes: Cressman, 14 November 1942: Kinugasa is sunk by USMC SBDs (VMSB 132), 15 nautical miles northwest of Rendova Island, 08°45'S, 157°00'E, in the attacks by planes from Enterprise and from Henderson Field. The unit is shore-based, and existing VMSB-132 Henderson claim C13076 (14 November) is in force. Confidence 0.5 (sea_position cap).

target_text: USMC SBDs (VMSB 132) from Henderson Field, with VS 10, VT 10, coast artillery and USS Meade, sink four beached Japanese transports off the northern coast of Guadalcanal
notes: Cressman, 15 November 1942: Navy SBDs (VS 10) and TBFs (VT 10), USMC SBDs (VMSB 132), Marine and Army coast artillery, and gunfire from destroyer Meade (DD-602) sink four Japanese merchant transport/cargo ships off the northern coast of Guadalcanal (Kinugasa Maru, Hirokawa Maru, Yamazuki Maru, and Yamura Maru). The unit is shore-based, and existing VMSB-132 Henderson claim C13076 (14 November) is in force. Confidence 0.7: one official Navy chronology (mission rubric). The target place is Ironbottom Sound (kind area), not a sea_position.
